name: spcChart
title: SPC Control Chart
description: Individuals control chart: values in order with centre line, upper/lower control limits and out-of-control points highlighted

category.description: One point per value, in the order they should be plotted (for example the batch ID, sorted by start date).

values.description: The measured value that is charted (one measure).

centre.description: The process mean. Optional: if empty it is computed from the plotted values.

upper.description: Usually mean + 3 sigma. Optional: if empty it is computed from the plotted values.

lower.description: Usually mean - 3 sigma. Optional: if empty it is computed from the plotted values.
